meta.title: teeTIM // natural fiber ... artificial design
meta.desc: TEETIM is a clothing designer based 100% in Quebec, designed by TIM students with the help of designs produced by artificial intelligence, and made with 100% natural and organic fibers.

accueil.amorceH1: T-shirts, hoodies, and caps made in Quebec 💯
accueil.amorceH4: /** with a little help from DALL-E 😉 **/
accueil.para1: Today, the T-shirt is an essential piece of clothing in everyone's wardrobe. And in an era when environmental concerns matter more than ever, we prefer T-shirts made in Quebec to reduce our environmental impact and highlight local craftsmanship.
accueil.para2: V-neck, crew-neck, loose or fitted, short-sleeved or long-sleeved for those who feel the cold, plain or patterned to add style to an outfit... The T-shirt is available in a variety of colors, styles, and patterns.
